---
name: Feature request
about: A style, a format, or a behaviour the tool should handle
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What are you trying to ship that the tool doesn't support today?
("My editor exports VTT and I have to convert by hand" beats
"add VTT".)

**What you'd want to see**
The command and the output shape you have in mind.

**If this involves a platform caption spec**
Link the platform's published spec or help page and quote the
figure from it (line length, reading speed, safe area). Specs are
only encoded with a source and a check date — the README's rule is
that no platform figure is presented as fact without one.

**The standing constraints, so the request fits the tool**
Standard library only (ffmpeg stays external); estimated word
timing stays labelled estimated; skipped cues stay reported.
